image.alt: Hudson County Motors Joins Forces with Toys for Tots to Spread Holiday Cheer

props.text:
[Jersey City, NJ] – [December 2, 2024] – Hudson County Motors is proud to announce its partnership with Toys for Tots this holiday season to host a Holiday Toy Drive dedicated to bringing joy to children in need within our community.
This heartfelt initiative reflects Hudson County Motors’ commitment to supporting local families and fostering the spirit of giving during the holidays. Community members are invited to participate by donating new and unwrapped toys to make the season brighter for children who may otherwise go without.

items.label: Where:
items.desc: Donation boxes are conveniently located in the sales and parts departments at Hudson County Motors.

items.label: When:
items.desc: Donations will be accepted through December 15th, 2024.

props.text:
“Partnering with Toys for Tots is a meaningful way to give back to the community and help brighten the holidays for children in need,” said Rachel O’Neill, Marketing Manager of Hudson County Motors. “We invite everyone to join us in spreading cheer and making a difference in the lives of local children.”
Toys for Tots has a long-standing tradition of ensuring that every child experiences the magic of the holidays. By contributing to the Hudson County Motors Toy Drive, you play a vital role in upholding this mission.
Together, let’s make this holiday season one to remember for every child in our community.

Hudson County Motors has been serving Secaucus, NJ with exceptional commercial vehicle solutions for over 70 years. Committed to community engagement, we strive to make a meaningful impact both on and off the road.

Since 1947, Toys for Tots has been delivering hope and joy to millions of children across the United States. Operated by the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve, the program collects and distributes toys to less fortunate children, helping them experience the magic of the holiday season.
